tasks.name: Ingest and build

tasks.name: Store
tasks.description: Lakehouse LH_MIZAN (brz, ctl, slv, quarantine, security, audit, meta, ai) and Warehouse WH_MIZAN (gld). Money is DECIMAL(18,2); never float.

tasks.name: Stream
tasks.description: Eventstream to Eventhouse. Velocity, mule-ring and reporting-SLA rules evaluated in KQL.

tasks.name: Model
tasks.description: Direct Lake semantic model over WH_MIZAN. No import, no scheduled refresh.

tasks.name: Report
tasks.description: Three pages: CFO Settlement, Tax ZATCA Health, CDO Data Trust.

tasks.name: Command Center
tasks.description: Fabric App front end and the user data function behind it.

tasks.name: Mirror
tasks.description: Open mirroring: the ERP merchant master arrives as CDC files in a OneLake landing zone and Fabric maintains the table -- no pipeline, no capacity spent on the copy. Unconnected on purpose: it is demonstrated, not wired into Gold (ADR-014).
